summary: 88 flags judged: ACT 29, ALREADY-DONE 19, DECLINE 36, DEFER-TO-LOUDON 4. Pattern. Of the 27 pheromone trails, 9 earn a link: where one page already cites the other in prose (unsung paths on SDKM, The Remembering Page, Skills Are Enchantable Pages, ELDER) or both pages hold the relation in their own words (Turrell-Rubin, McGilchrist-Oliveros, Piano-Portamento, Biomechanical-Crystal, Philosopher Visits-No Mind Checks Itself). Four of the nine change the trail's side or type so the page that carries the reason holds the link. The other 18 fade by design: costume quotations (the four Adjacent Affordance voices), outside readings no page states, two pages deleted in September, a precondition that no longer exists. Of the 9 map rhymes, 1 earns a link (Volterra-Chebyshev, each page holding half of one exact claim); the rest already meet through a page that names the shared idea, or neither page names it. Reciprocal links asked for by the Haptic Handwheel and others are all declined, because one link per pair already holds each; body lines for the unbuilt knob wait for the build, except the Portamento open question, where a proposal honestly sits. Most older Closing Well asks are done: the last eight faces (b7fc35ff, 322 of 322), the tooling seams, the worktree gap, the calibration home, the three citizens. Only four ALREADY-DONE flags are closed by a trailer already (1792590978864, 1792647281022, 1792647280829, 1792887839141); the other 15 need Palace-Resolves in the Weave commit. Read from the working tree while Phase 2b and 2c landed (ed04958f, b7fc35ff); the ACT pairs were rechecked against frontmatter after both.
